attr.title: Super Mario 64 Co-op DX
attr.desc: Super Mario 64 Co-op DX for aarch64 handhelds. A build of sm64coopdx with online multiplayer, widescreen and Lua modding support.
attr.inst: Copy your legally obtained US Super Mario 64 ROM to ports/sm64coopdx/ as a .z64 file (e.g. baserom.us.z64). The launcher renames it automatically on first run.
